source_quote: The mission of the Healthcare Information Systems program is devoted to providing
answer: The HCIS program's mission is a state-of-the-art curriculum, industry relationships, professional responsibility and lifelong learning. Graduates should solve healthcare computing problems, show professional and ethical behavior, and progress in employment or graduate studies.

source_quote: An ability to apply health analytic methods to influence the planning, organizing,
answer: HCIS outcomes: apply health information systems knowledge and tools; use health analytics for planning and policy; design and evaluate healthcare systems; ensure quality and compliance; teamwork; understand ethical, legal and security issues; communicate effectively; and pursue professional development.

source_quote: variety of settings such as hospitals, long-term-care facilities, insurance and managed
answer: HCIS graduates can work with healthcare providers and technical specialists in hospitals, long-term-care facilities, insurance and managed care organizations, government agencies and vendor firms, including regulatory compliance and quality assessment roles.

source_quote: RHU’s Healthcare Information Systems (HCIS) program combines concepts from
answer: The HCIS program combines healthcare, information technology and leadership to prepare designers and developers of health information systems, building computational, critical thinking, communication and teamwork skills.

source_quote: To obtain a Bachelor of Science degree in HCIS, the student must complete 100 credit
answer: The BS in Healthcare Information Systems requires 100 credit hours over six semesters and two summer sessions: General Education 31, Program Requirements 69 (major 51 mandatory + 9 elective; non-major 31 mandatory + 9 elective).
review_note: Program requirement percentage printed as 69% on p.159 but 70% on p.113; values otherwise consistent.

source_quote: MATH 421 Numerical Analysis 3 MATH 311
answer: HCIS mathematics requirements: MATH 210, MATH 215, MATH 311, MATH 421 (prereq MATH 311). Business requirements: BMGT 300 Project Management (Junior Standing) and BMKA 200 Introduction to Marketing (co-req ENGL 210).

source_quote: The HCIS mandatory core courses are listed in the table below.
answer: HCIS mandatory core: COSC 215, 231, 316, 333, 341, 360, 360L, 480; HCIS 240 Medical Terminology, HCIS 341, HCIS 342, HCIS 343, HCIS 399 Co-op, HCIS 444, HCIS 445, and HCIS 490 Summative Learning Experience.

answer: The HCIS core table lists BIOL 210 as the prerequisite for HCIS 341 Health Information Systems I.

answer: HCIS 342 Health Information Systems II, HCIS 343 Information Security and Privacy in Healthcare, and HCIS 444 Healthcare Business Intelligence & Data Analysis (3 credits each) all require HCIS 341.

source_quote: HCIS 445 Research in Healthcare Information 1 Senior Standing
answer: HCIS 445 Research in Healthcare Information Systems is 1 credit and requires Senior Standing.

source_quote: HCIS 399 Co-op Training Experience 1 ENGL 217; Senior
answer: HCIS 399 Co-op Training Experience (1 credit) requires ENGL 217 and Senior Standing; HCIS 490 Summative Learning Experience (3 credits) requires ENGL 217.

source_quote: students must complete 9 credit hours of technical electives. These courses allow
answer: HCIS students take 9 credits of technical electives chosen with the advisor, e.g., BIOM 520 Health-care Facility Management, BIOM 565 Introduction to E-Healthcare (both require HCIS 341), COSC 434, 435, 436, 438, 451, 461, 463, 481, 482, 498, HCIS 498 (Senior Standing), CCEE 561, CCEE 566; the list is subject to change. Three networking labs (COSC 460L, 461L, 462L) may replace one elective.

source_quote: The SLP could be an extension of the projects students worked on in the
answer: HCIS students complete a 3-credit summative learning project, preferably in groups, on an industry or community problem or innovative idea, possibly extending projects from the Engineering for the Community course.

source_quote: Senior Standing are prerequisites for co-op training, the program must stipulate
answer: HCIS students complete 8 weeks of practical training, usually in the summer of the third year, mentored by a faculty member with field visits, and submit a formal report and poster plus a presentation; ENGL 217 and Senior Standing are prerequisites and the program stipulates additional conditions.

source_quote: Code numbers designate the courses offered in the HCIS program in the form of (HCIS
answer: HCIS course codes have the form HCIS abc: a = year/level; b = focus area (1 Software Engineering and Quality Assurance, 2 Network Administration and Security, 3 Healthcare); c = sequence within the area.

answer: HCIS Year 1 Fall (15 credits): ARAB 212, BMKA 200, a 1-credit Community & Sustainability course, COSC 214, ENGL 210, and MATH 215.

source_quote: Year 1, Spring Semester (16 Credits)
answer: HCIS Year 1 Spring (16 credits): COSC 215, COSC 231, CMNS 205 First Aid, ENGL 217, HCIS 240, MATH 210. Year 1 Summer (6 credits): BIOL 210 and Social Science/Culture Elective I.

source_quote: Year 2, Fall Semester (16 Credits)
answer: HCIS Year 2 Fall (16 credits): COSC 316, COSC 333, COSC 360, COSC 360L, HCIS 341, MATH 351.

source_quote: Year 2, Spring Semester (15 Credits)
answer: HCIS Year 2 Spring (15 credits): COSC 341, HCIS 342, HCIS 343, MATH 311, HCIS Major Elective I; Year 2 Summer (1 credit): HCIS 399 Co-op Training Experience.

source_quote: Year 3, Fall Semester (15 Credits)
answer: HCIS Year 3 Fall (15 credits): MATH 421, GRDS 440, HCIS 444, a Humanities/Fine Arts Elective, and HCIS Major Elective II.

source_quote: Year 3, Spring Semester (16 Credits)
answer: HCIS Year 3 Spring (16 credits): BMGT 300, COSC 480, HCIS 490, HCIS 445, HCIS Major Elective III, and Social Sciences/Culture Elective II.

answer: HCIS 240 Medical Terminology, 3(3,0): foundations of terms for the human body and conditions, procedures and common medications, spelling, pronunciation and abbreviations. Prerequisite: None.

source_quote: This course introduces healthcare, medical, and business processes from a software
answer: HCIS 341 Health Information Systems I, 3(3,0): healthcare, medical and business processes from a software design perspective, the healthcare delivery process, hospital IT functions, and interactions between healthcare and business data domains.
